name: Create order (start checkout)
description: A logged-in student pays for one class. The order starts as 'pending' and the student is sent to the gateway; enrolment only happens when the gateway's signed webhook confirms the payment. ({{course_slug}} is filled in by the test; channel 'mock' is the local test gateway and only works outside production. `agree: true` is the box the buyer ticks to accept the terms, the privacy policy and the refund & cancellation policy; without it nothing is ordered.)
